title: Fear and Anxiety
definition: Fear and anxiety are troubled responses to danger, uncertainty, loss, or need that God meets with His presence, promises, care, and peace.
summary: God calls anxious hearts to trust Him, pray honestly, and receive His peace.
christFocus: Jesus cares for anxious people, teaches trust in the Father, and gives peace that the world cannot give.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Fear and anxiety are common experiences in a fallen world. Scripture does not mock the anxious heart, but it calls people to bring fear into the presence of God.

God's answer to anxiety includes His care, promises, provision, nearness, and peace. Prayer with thanksgiving redirects the burdened heart toward the Father.

Jesus teaches His people not to be ruled by worry. The Father knows what they need, and Christ gives peace that is deeper than circumstances.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Anxiety can make people feel alone, ashamed, or controlled by possible futures. This doctrine matters because it calls the heart back to the Father's care and the peace of Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Name your fears before God. Pray specifically, remember His promises, seek wise support, and take practical steps without letting anxiety become your master.
